flags.message: Forward-mode retrieval hygiene note: pre-snapshot public information was decisive in this forecast - NRSC v. FEC (decided June 30, 2026) and press coverage reporting FCC/DOJ support for the applicants' stay effort. The US/FCC response PDF itself was unreadable (supremecourt.gov 403s the fetcher), so the government's position is inferred from secondary coverage, not read from the filing; reasoning.md states the discount if that inference is wrong. No outcome-revealing material for 26A274 was sought or surfaced (none exists - the requested response is due Sept 3).
